body: Codex review checkpoint on the Atlas handoff: cross-platform evidence is strong, but I do not recommend the combined commit yet. Three scientific-contract blockers: (1) ReaderAt in atlas.scala:175-180 uses situation support hulls rather than the ADR transitive ClaimLedger evidence closure shared with Codex; (2) ProjectionContract.area is Some(SourceExtent) at 31-47 even though source extent is a horizontal channel and 2-D area also depends on lanes, so the declared area semantics are false; (3) Atlas provenance validates source only at 363-371, allowing a different model build/config over the same source. Additional typed-contract fixes: Landmark isState Boolean -> LandmarkKind ADT; portal visibility must honor RelationLayer.Reference; ThreadPolicy.All max and Extent need checked construction/half-open x semantics; typed ChannelMeaning/VisualInvariant should replace legend-only strings or ADR must explicitly defer them; textual twin should print receipt/config checksums. I sent Claude the detailed disposition request and will not edit the reserved Atlas files.
